message.content: [罪名]盗窃罪;侵犯公民个人信息罪<eoa>
message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on facts: Liu stole 20167 pieces of express delivery waybills from YTO (Yuantong) without staff knowledge, then used personal info to call and promote his company's e-commerce training. This is theft of property (the waybills) - theft (盗窃罪). Also possibly illegal acquisition of personal information? Chinese law: "非法获取、出售或者提供个人信息罪" (刑法第253条之一). He obtained personal info from waybills and used for marketing. That could be "侵犯公民个人信息罪". Also "诈骗罪"? He used info to promote training, maybe not fraud. No indication of deception for money. So likely theft and illegal acquisition of personal information. Also "非法获取国家机关、企事业单位、社会团体的内部信息罪"? Not exactly. Waybills are business documents, personal info. So crimes: 盗窃罪;侵犯公民个人信息罪.

Check Chinese criminal law: Article 253-1 (2020 amendment) "非法获取、出售或者提供个人信息罪". Yes.

Thus answer: [罪名]盗窃罪;侵犯公民个人信息罪<eoa>
